mapper.select: SELECT city_code, city_name, province_name, lon, lat FROM t_city WHERE city_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR city_code = #{keyword} ORDER BY city_code LIMIT 20

SELECT c.city_code, c.city_name, c.province_name, c.lon, c.lat, m.year, m.month, m.price FROM t_city c JOIN t_monthly_price m ON m.city_code = c.city_code WHERE m.year = #{year} AND m.month = #{month} AND m.price IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.price DESC
